function.name: book_video_call
function.description: Book the chosen ISO-8601 slot on the rep's calendar and email the prospect a video-call invite. Call mark_for_transfer FIRST, then collect email, then call this.

slot_iso.description: ISO-8601 datetime with timezone, e.g. 2026-05-08T14:30:00-07:00. Must come from a get_available_slots [iso:...] tag.

messages.content: Just one sec, brother — pulling that up.
